scope: Propagate cancellation through export planning, registry/directory/source reads and final validation, stop on internal output failure, preserve existing jobs for pre-cancelled requests, and synchronize HTTP cleanup tests with server download completion

before.sourceState: Final regression test replayed against the preceding N104–N105 worktree in an isolated temporary copy. All three restored production hashes match function network revision 48; current worktree preserved.
before.reproduction: Preparation/final checks kept issuing authored-data reads after cancellation or output failure, late malformed source replaced cancellation, and pre-cancelled creation removed an existing completed job. Thirteen regressions failed; valid late source plus ordinary malformed source/registry repair cases passed.

initialFocusedRun.failure: The existing HTTP cleanup test expected 500 for inactive-job deletion, but received the intended 200 while the server still retained an active reader after client EOF.
initialFocusedRun.resolution: Wait for the actual server request handler to finish before injecting inactive-job removal failure. The same completion barrier protects the new HTTP retry test.

application.skipReason: Node-driven native archive interop and registry-agreement groups require VIENTO_TEST_ARCHIVE_BINARY; b.3.9 release evidence remains. No Rust sources or registry validation rules changed.
